subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A patient with liver cirrhosis and elevated ammonia levels is demonstrating signs of encephalopathy. How might protein intake be managed in this specific acute phase?
options: Temporarily restrict protein, then gradually increase as tolerated.
questions.explain: While adequate protein is needed for liver regeneration, in severe hepatic encephalopathy (where ammonia, a protein byproduct, accumulates), protein may be temporarily restricted and then re-introduced based on tolerance.
